comparison_semantics.wave_table: actual PRIV capped table equals full[:cap]; privileged diagnostic only, never actor/course input
comparison_semantics.controls: Identical action from full public observation; wait300 or unchanged scripted controller. Check every decision boundary. No adaptive control/seed deletion.
intended_boundaries: real capped win, with intentionally different terminal state
comparison_semantics.normal_loss: same battle state/tick and actual terminal result required; loss is retained as a valid prefix case
comparison_semantics.no_claim: Boundary checks do not prove equality at every internal tick, solvability, RL learning or full-game success.

coexecution: After full pool diagnostic ends, two single-thread prefix workers (four native processes) alongside corrected reevaluation; no GPU model/optimizer.
limitations: No actor training/weights or validation sampling; fixed controls are never PPO data.
Original manifests/failures kept unchanged; all 30 task seed blocks retained.
Any genuine physics/table/normal-loss difference stops the new gate; no override.
Inspection is a subset, not a full64-seed gate.
This audit concerns task-prefix semantics, not a course learning/frontier/target-feature benefit.
release_rule: Draft only; release full prefix only after complete passing120-pair prefix inspection and completed full pool diagnostic; add immutable report hashes without changing cases/controls/fields/stops.
